# DQYDJ (Don't Quit Your Day Job)

> > Data-driven analysis of personal finance, economics, and investing with calculators, income/wealth statistics, and behavioral finance insights.

DQYDJ provides quantitative analysis of economic data, particularly US income and wealth distributions, alongside investment strategy research and financial calculators. The site combines Federal Reserve data (FRED), Census Bureau statistics, and S&P 500 analysis to explore personal finance topics ranging from wealth building to behavioral economics.

## Key Topics

- Income percentiles and wealth distribution
- S&P 500 and stock market analysis
- Personal finance calculators
- Behavioral finance and cognitive biases
- CPI and inflation metrics
- Federal Reserve economic data (FRED)
- Dollar cost averaging vs lump sum investing
- Net worth percentiles
- Educational attainment and earnings
- Gambler's fallacy and pattern recognition
- Economic policy and price controls
- Wealth vs income distinction
- Side hustle and gig economy earnings
- Market corrections and business cycles
- Financial ratio calculators

## Income and Wealth Calculators

- [Income Percentile Calculator for the United States in 2018](https://dqydj.com/2018-income-percentile-calculator): 2018 US individual income percentile calculator with distribution stats
- [Net Worth Percentile Calculator for the United States in 2016](https://dqydj.com/2016-net-worth-percentile-calculator-united-states): 2016 US household net worth percentile calculator & wealth distribution tool
- [Workforce by Age Calculator for the United States](https://dqydj.com/workforce-by-age-calculator-united-states): US workforce age demographics calculator with CSV export from 1962-present

## Personal Finance and Wealth Building

- [Wealth is Not Income: Here's the Difference](https://dqydj.com/wealth-is-not-income): Personal finance guide distinguishing wealth from income with Buffett example
- [Can You Get Rich with Stocks? A Case Study of Growing Wealth](https://dqydj.com/get-rich-with-stocks): Ronald Read case study on wealth building through stock market investing
- [Dollar Cost Averaging vs. Lump Sum Investing: Which is better for you?](https://dqydj.com/dollar-cost-averaging-vs-lump-sum): DCA vs lump sum investment strategy comparison using S&P 500 historical data
- [How Do Home Buyers Pay for Homes in the United States?](https://dqydj.com/source-of-funds-home-purchase): FHFA & CFPB survey data analysis on home purchase funding sources

## Income and Career Analysis

- [Income Change: How Career Income Changes By Age](https://dqydj.com/income-change-career-income-increase-age): Longitudinal career income growth analysis using Census Bureau IPUMS-CPS data
- [2020 Income by Education: Average, Top One Percent, Median, and Percentiles](https://dqydj.com/2020-income-by-education): 2020 income statistics by educational attainment with percentile breakdowns
- [How Much Do Americans Earn From Side Jobs?](https://dqydj.com/income-earned-side-jobs-america): Federal Reserve SHED data analysis on side hustle & gig economy earnings

## Behavioral Finance and Economic Psychology

- [The Gambler's Fallacy: Zodiac Signs and Other Oddities](https://dqydj.com/gamblers-fallacy): Behavioral finance article on gambler's fallacy using Chinese Zodiac & S&P 500
- [The Lottery-Insurance Paradox](https://dqydj.com/lottery-insurance-paradox): Behavioral economics explaining risk-seeking vs risk-averse behavior paradox
- [Can You Beat Game Shows? Mike Larson and Charles Van Doren & More](https://dqydj.com/beat-game-shows-recognize-patterns): Pattern recognition analysis of Mike Larson, Van Doren beating game shows

## Economic Policy and Market Analysis

- [A Quick Market Correction, An Inverted Yield Curve, and a Corona](https://dqydj.com/feb-2020-market-correction-covid-19): S&P 500 market correction analysis during COVID-19 pandemic onset Feb 2020
- [Comparing Methods of Inflation Prediction: Inflation Surveys](https://dqydj.com/inflation-prediction-methods): Fed Atlanta, Philadelphia & U Michigan inflation survey forecasting comparison
- [Would Negative Savings Account Interest Rates Work in the United States?](https://dqydj.com/negative-savings-accounts): Analysis of negative interest rates & real returns on US savings accounts
- [The Moral Case Against Price Controls](https://dqydj.com/the-moral-case-against-price-controls): Economic policy argument against price ceilings, floors & minimum wage

## Financial Ratio Calculators

- [Cash Return on Invested Capital – CROIC Calculator](https://dqydj.com/croic-calculator): CROIC financial metric calculator for capital efficiency & free cash flow
- [Quick Ratio Calculator](https://dqydj.com/quick-ratio-calculator): Acid-test liquidity ratio calculator for company short-term solvency

## Optional

- [How Many Faithless Electors Were There in 2020?](https://dqydj.com/how-many-faithless-electors-2020): 2020 electoral college analysis: Biden-Trump election with zero faithless electors
